investment.heroSubtitle: Tangible real estate assets with strong use value, driven by structural demand.
investment.conceptP1: I-CA.RE acquires undervalued urban ground floors (150 to 200 sqm) and transforms them into next-generation healthcare and well-being spaces.
investment.conceptP2: Each asset hosts 7 to 10 independent offices (12–18 sqm), designed for confidentiality, acoustic performance and comfort. The granular multi-tenant structure structurally reduces vacancy risk.
investment.executionModelDesc: An integrated value chain, from acquisition to exit.
investment.forInvestorsP1: I-CA.RE structures healthcare real estate operations with an entrepreneurial sponsor-led model. The investor contributes 100% of equity; I-CA.RE contributes 100% of the industry: development, engineering, construction, leasing, asset management and exit strategy.
investment.forInvestorsP2: Our investment memo details the financial model, distribution structure (waterfall), governance and roadmap.
investment.accessNote: Confidential access after submitting a short form. No commitment required.
investment.partnersDesc: Banks, estate agents, landlords: we are looking for partners aligned with our model.
investment.exchangeDesc: Receive our detailed investment memo or schedule a confidential meeting with our team.

professionals.heroTitle: Set up your practice in a space built to last
professionals.heroSubtitle: Turnkey, compliant, bright and purpose-designed spaces for your practice.
professionals.whySubtitle: Three pillars for a seamless practice.

pillars.securityDesc: ERP compliance, disability access, fire and health standards: every office is delivered to current regulations. Zero risk, zero surprises.
pillars.comfortDesc: Offices from 12 to 18 sqm, natural light, enhanced acoustic insulation and premium materials. Each space is designed for confidentiality and practice comfort.
pillars.supportDesc: From lease signing to opening, we handle the paperwork: insurance, utilities, signage, maintenance. You focus on your patients.

steps.proposalDesc: We present available or upcoming spaces suited to your practice and preferred area.
steps.fitoutDesc: We manage the fit-out of your office to your requirements, meeting all health and accessibility standards.
steps.installDesc: Key handover, operational support and post-move-in follow-up. You practise with confidence from day one.

approach.heroSubtitle: Vision, method and commitment in service of community health.
approach.founderQuote: I founded I-CA.RE with the conviction that access to healthcare is a fundamental challenge for our communities. By renovating healthcare spaces, we create the conditions for local, human and high-quality medicine.
approach.desertSubtitle: Figures that drive us to act, every day.
approach.stat1Label: people in France without a GP
approach.stat3Label: of the territory classified as a medical tension zone
approach.desertP1: In France, millions of people live in areas where access to healthcare has become difficult. Doctors are retiring, outdated premises stand empty, and residents are moving further from health services.
approach.desertP2: I-CA.RE provides a concrete answer: we identify high-potential buildings, transform them into modern healthcare spaces, and settle practitioners in optimal conditions.
approach.valuesSubtitle: The principles that guide every decision we make.

values.responsibilityDesc: We embrace our role in improving access to healthcare for all.
values.impactDesc: Every project strengthens the healthcare fabric of a neighbourhood, a city.
values.careDesc: Towards practitioners, patients, neighbours and our partners.
values.excellenceDesc: Architectural and technical quality in service of care.
values.pragmatismDesc: Concrete solutions, rooted in the realities of communities.

approach.methodDesc: Every I-CA.RE project follows a proven methodology that guarantees quality delivery and operational success. From sourcing to management, we control the entire value chain.

steps.s1Desc: We identify areas of medical tension and buildings with high transformation potential.
steps.s2Desc: We carry out an in-depth study of the building and its environment to validate the project's potential.
steps.s3Desc: Our architectural partners (Rivage IC and IDNéa) design spaces optimised for healthcare.
steps.s4Desc: Our partner Inside BAT manages the refurbishment works with rigour and respect for deadlines.
steps.s5Desc: We recruit healthcare professionals and assemble a balanced multidisciplinary team.
steps.s6Desc: We support opening and provide long-term technical and tenancy management.

approach.partnersDesc: We surround ourselves with the finest experts to guarantee excellence in delivery.

partners.rivageDesc: Architectural practice specialising in healthcare and well-being projects.
partners.idneaDesc: Technical consultancy for optimising healthcare spaces.
partners.insidebatDesc: General contractor, expert in high-quality refurbishment.

approach.teamSubtitle: Complementary expertise serving a shared mission.
approach.collectivitesDesc: I-CA.RE supports local authorities in creating healthcare centres that are attractive to professionals and accessible to residents.

collectivitesBenefits.serviceDesc: Bring healthcare professionals back to your area and improve access to care for your residents.
collectivitesBenefits.heritageDesc: Give new life to underused or degraded buildings through quality refurbishment.
collectivitesBenefits.employmentDesc: Create local jobs and enhance the appeal of your area for residents and businesses.
collectivitesBenefits.securityDesc: Benefit from a solid operator committed to long-term management and community engagement.

approach.caseStudyContextDesc: A town of 17,000 inhabitants on the outskirts of Bordeaux, Floirac faced an acute shortage of healthcare professionals.
approach.caseStudySolutionDesc: Refurbishment of a former 800 sqm retail unit into a multidisciplinary healthcare hub, with 8 offices and full disability access.
approach.ctaTitle: Want to contribute to this vision?
approach.ctaDesc: Whether you are a health professional, a local authority or an investor, join us in this mission.
